body: Extract text and structured data from images and PDFs in more than 100 languages.
plain_description: **Turn PDFs and images into structured data your business can use.** Extract text and document details into JSON or Markdown, across more than 100 languages. Use the results to prepare information for AI and document workflows.
technical_description: PaddleOCR is an OCR toolkit and document AI engine for recognizing text and parsing documents. It converts PDFs and images to structured JSON or Markdown, supports multilingual recognition, and includes document parsing for tables, formulas, charts, and other elements. The README describes local inference, browser inference, service deployment, and integrations with tools such as Dify and RAGFlow.
title: PaddleOCR
